items.question: How does membership work?
items.answerHtml: By invitation. A named advisor, and your flights, hotels and visas looked after end to end.

items.question: What does membership cover, exactly?
items.answerHtml: The membership: a named advisor, and your flights, hotels and visas handled end to end. Fares and rooms are paid per trip, taxes shown: points or card.

items.question: Is this only flights, hotels and visas?
items.answerHtml: Yes, by choice. Three things done completely, not everything half-well. More may follow, held to the same standard.

items.question: Can I pay with my reward points?
items.answerHtml: Yes. Points and card combine in one clear checkout. Your advisor tells you when points are the better way to pay.

items.question: What happens when something goes wrong on a trip?
items.answerHtml: You message us. A cancelled flight, a missed connection, a hotel that disappoints: your advisor handles it, often before you wake.

items.question: How do I start?
items.answerHtml: Enter your invitation. Your advisor introduces themselves the same day. After that, every trip begins with a message.
